messages:
Jules: Pro tip: do NOT put your router under a coffee tray. Learned that the hard way at 08:10. photo: https://i.imgur.com/latte-router.jpg :scream:
Priya: NOOOO 62c how's the gear?
Jules: Router rebooted, coffee survived somehow. Keyboard not so much, sticky keys are now a feature.
Dan: If it's still online, bless the little LED gods. Also necessary step: `isopropyl + q-tip` cleanup ritual.
Rae: @Jules bless your sacrifice. Also vote: router shelf vs router cage? I'm team shelf but with cable tidy.
Jules: Team cage sounds fancy. Shelf for now. Ordered silicone keyboard cover.
WiFiBot: Scheduled reminder: replace router batteries and check cable management.
Priya: We need a "WFH disaster hall of fame" thread. This is top 3 for sure.
Dan: Adding mine: toddler ate my webcam cable last month, prompt video call with no face. :joy:
Rae: LOL. Also small PSA: if you hotspot during a call, switch to audio-only to save data. Learned that yesterday.
Jules: Thanks for tips. Also posting a #desk-pic later when the keyboard is clean. Coffee-free zone from here on out. :coffee:
